entity.name: Diagram Chasing
entity.description: Diagram Chasing is an independent data journalism and visualisation collective based in India. We build interactive stories, maps, and explorables that make public data legible and meaningful, covering elections, urban infrastructure, climate, policy, and other topics from India.

projects.name: Diagram Chasing
projects.description: An independent data journalism and visualisation studio. We produce open, interactive data stories on topics like cities, climate, censorship, government data and more from India. All published work is freely accessible and our code is open source.

channels.description: Pay via Razorpay using UPI, debit/credit card, or net banking.

plans.name: Research & Development
plans.description: Funds independent R&D; new tools, datasets, and experimental formats that underpin our published work.

plans.name: Commissioning
plans.description: Supports commissioning contributors such as writers, designers, and developers to produce data stories and explorables.

plans.name: Events
plans.description: Covers costs for public events, workshops, and community gatherings around data, journalism, and civic technology.

plans.name: General support
plans.description: Any amount helps! Please contribute what you can to keep our independent work going
